thread:
maria: heads up — saw a discrepancy in token counts for short streaming sessions when the router samples ACKs across the tail window. looks like provisional credits spike.

kai: can you paste the example trace? :thinking:

maria: sure — repro on staging. client starts stream, gets 1 token then reconnects quickly, backend sends suffix toolcall; console shows provisional + confirmed both counting the tail.

maria: log excerpt:
```
TRACE 2026-03-18T22:11:07Z session=abcd start_chunk=0 tokens=1 provisional=true
TRACE 2026-03-18T22:11:09Z session=abcd reconnect start_chunk=1 toolcall=suffix tokens=3 provisional=true
LEDGER 2026-03-18T22:11:10Z commit session=abcd confirmed_tokens=4
```

dinesh: so provisional and confirmed both include overlap? that would double-bill the overlap.

sam: exact problem we've seen with tiny windows and router sampling. the router marks provisional on first route then a handoff confirms and both sides emit charge events.

maria: yep. on staging the provisional window is 250ms and handoff confirmation arrives inside it frequently for low-latency clients.

kai: could be our sampling TTL + heartbeat race. current heuristic: provisional expires after 500ms, but routers emit a provisional counter immediately. if confirmation arrives before cleanup, we keep provisional until reconcilation job removes it.

dinesh: what's the delta in tokens? small in absolute but triggers alerts when many concurrent microstreams happen (background embeddings batch fallback).

maria: measured ~1.8x spike during a simulated reconnect flood. dashboards flagged a provisional spike metric (provisional_tokens_per_min).

sam: proposal: change provisional emission to include a routing-id fingerprint and only mark provisional if no identical fingerprint confirmation is expected within X ms. basically defer provisional emit by 50ms for microstreams.

kai: deferring risks slightly higher latency on billing visibility, but reduces noise. we could expose a console toggle per-customer for aggressive-defer vs instant-provisional.

dinesh: alternative: emit provisional as usual but mark provisional as "overlap_possible" and include overlap_fingerprint in telemetry. then billing pipeline dedupes confirmed against overlap_fingerprint on finalize.

maria: I like dedupe at finalization because it keeps metrics real-time but avoids actual double charges. downside: more state in ledger finalizer.

sam: finalizer changes are nontrivial; dedupe needs a stable id — we could use (session_id, last_chunk_id, route_fingerprint).

kai: also need UI hint: show provisional tokens and "likely overlap" flag on route details. ops-bot: create ticket for finalizer dedupe or deferred provisional? :point_up:

ops-bot: Created issue INF-2026: investigate provisional overlap dedupe vs deferred-provisional (assignee: dinesh). Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-2026

dinesh: I'll prototype finalizer dedupe. plan: add overlap_fingerprint to provisional events, then on confirmation check for matching fingerprints within a 2s window and subtract provisional ledger entry before billing snapshot.

maria: also can we add a short-term telemetry graph for "provisional overlap rate" in the console (per-model and per-route)? helps customers understand noise.

kai: agreed — add a small badge next to token counters: % overlap last 5m. product-ux can decide wording.

sam: opt-in default for small customers? for enterprises we enable dedupe automatically.

dinesh: will post a short design doc with shapes and failure modes in #eng-platform later today.

maria: thanks — will coordinate with billing and support so we don't alarm customers when we flip behavior.

kai: perfect. follow-up: if anyone has replay traces (with session ids) drop them here or DM dinesh. :thumbsup:
